Brief facts of the care are that, on 14.11.2012 the deceased Rafiulla and Mujahid Pasha were coming to Channarayapatna from Hassan in their motor bike bearing Reg.No.KA-19-J-8711 on NH.48 on the left side of the road.

When they reached near Ranganathapura Kenchakatte, a lorry bearing Reg.No.KA-13-A-6682 came from Shanthigrama village towards Hassan side, in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the motor bike, in which, Rafiulla and Mujahid Pasha were travelling caused the accident.
In the result, both rider and pillion rider died at spot.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 21.10.2014 in MVC.No.1035/2013 and MVC.No.1034/2013 passed by Fast Track Court and Addl. MACT, Channarayapatna,
is modified to the extent that the appellants/claimants in MFA.No.6383/2015 are entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.8,51,400/- and the appellants/claimants in MFA.No.6382/2015 are entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.8,51,400/- along with interest at the rate - 16 - of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
iii.
The appellants/claimants are not entitled for interest for the delay period of 193 days in both the appeals.
iv. No order as to costs.
